play.helpDigital: Everyone plays on their own phone. In Play, tap a square to grey it out and cross it out; tap again to remove the mark. Undo reverses the last move. Your answer opens a full-screen answer type and entry form. Confirming covers your answer; tap the cover to reveal it. The host plays too: in Host, draw a category, start the timer when the music begins, then choose Answer and play. The clock stays visible above your board and while entering, hiding and revealing your answer. The default time is 25 seconds. In Settings, choose the level, new game, time from 1 to 300 seconds, sound, printing, language and application options. Editing the time pauses the countdown; start it again in Host. Boards and rounds are saved locally, without syncing between devices.
play.hostHint: Draw a category, start the timer and choose Answer and play. The clock stays visible on your board and answer screen.
play.helpBingo: A full row, column or diagonal makes Bingo and triggers confetti and fireworks. Open Board in Settings to start a new game with a 3 × 3, 4 × 4 or 5 × 5 grid. Settle all answers and bonuses from the same round. If needed, judge a tie-break together after the next song.
